name: vision-track
description: Track objects in a video in the workspace ("track the cars in clips/street.mp4"): RF-DETR (rfdetr, Apache-2.0) finds them in every frame and Roboflow trackers (Apache-2.0: ByteTrack by default, or SORT, OC-SORT, BoT-SORT, C-BIoU) keeps their IDs. Writes an annotated MP4 (boxes, IDs, traces) and a JSON/CSV summary per track into tracks/. Runs on CPU, Apple MPS or CUDA. Set up with: python tools/setup_extras.py vision. The network permission is only for the detector's one-time weights download on first use; the video never leaves this computer. LOKI's `track` specialist.
